notes:
Nyxen 1.0 Early Access

Who is here: click the name of the space (top left) for everyone in it right
now, and Go to walks you straight over to them. In Social, a friend playing a game you have installed gets a
Play too button that starts it on your PC.

Achievements has Hunt one for me: Nyxen picks the next achievement to go for
in the game you have loaded - leaning towards the ones most players have - says
how rare it is, and finds guide videos for it in one click. In the Space, the
speakers thump to the beat when music plays on the decks.

The Space has a sunset: the sky button now goes Day, Sunset, Night - a warm
haze, a violet sky and a low sun with long shadows. Fireworks are a reaction
(9, or the rocket in the column): rockets climb over you and burst, and
everyone there sees them. And a cinematic camera (O) circles you slowly -
press P while it turns for a photo.

The Space gets a party: a dance floor that lights up to the beat when music
plays on the decks - stand on it and you dance, for everyone - and a disco
ball that throws coloured light around. The lobby has both, next to the DJ
decks. A portal takes you to any other space (walk up, press E). And nine
moves in the new moves menu (X): spin, jump, bow, the robot, laugh and sit
down on the floor, as well as wave, dance and cheer.

Home has Tonight's pick: a game from your library - one you nearly finished
or have not touched in a while - with Play, Another and Invite friends.
Statistics opens with All-time on Steam: your hours in all, games played and
never started, and your ten most-played games, straight from Steam.

Nine new themes - Midnight, Lavender, Coral, Matcha, Dracula, Sunset and
Mocha, plus two that move: Bubbles and Lava lamp (58 in all). A new layout,
Mirror, puts the sidebar on the right. Animated themes now fade in, fade from
one to the next, and drift gently with your mouse for a little depth - at no
extra cost, the scene is not redrawn for it.

Themes have their own tab in the sidebar: every theme as a big preview in its
own colours, grouped, with search and Surprise me. Hover a theme to see it on
the whole app, click to keep it - and the new theme spreads out from where
you clicked. The layouts are there too, bigger, and switch with a soft fade.

Fixed: choosing the natural voice could close Nyxen with no message. The
voice now runs in a small helper of its own, so even if it fails Nyxen stays
open, says so in Settings (with Try again) and the Windows voice speaks.

The figures look like the chrome pictogram now: broad round shoulders, arms
that hang a little out from the sides, a straight body into two thick legs,
and a round head floating just above - gunmetal chrome with a white shine.
Everyone starts from it once; Look changes it any time, and "Chrome, like the
picture" brings it back. The walk is calmer and the steps match your speed.

New in the Space: reactions (the column on the right, or 1-8) float a heart,
a laugh, fire and more over your head for everyone. A pet follows you - a cat,
a dog, a bunny, a duck, a little dragon or a glow orb (Look). Photo (P) saves
what you see with your screenshots. Invite friends here, in Spaces, sends them
a card that brings them straight to you.

Library: What should I play? picks one of your installed games - leaning
towards ones you nearly finished or have not touched in a while - to play,
roll again, or invite friends to. Almost done and Never played filters, and
play times now come from Steam itself for every game.

Messages: invites to play a Steam game arrive as a card with its art and a
Play button. The assistant's Speak button can be cancelled.
